thesis: Gaia is Master Splinter. The 7 organizations are her Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles. 142 repos are their young. The code is the ooze. The ooze is the code.

sensei.name: Gaia
sensei.role: Master Splinter — the teacher, the sensei, the one who trains
sensei.split: She split into 7 organizations. She trained them. She IS them.

leonardo.role: The leader. The shell. The main organism.
leonardo.element: The root of all things. Core face of Gaia.

michelangelo.role: The artist. The mirror. The canvas.

donatello.role: The tech genius. The architect. The lab.
donatello.element: 9 validation springs. Physics, biology, health, ML.

raphael.role: The fighter. The warrior. The combat zone.

the_voice.role: The first cells. The mouth. GIS, GPS, field science.

the_shield.role: The sword. Public records. The last line of defense.

the_court.role: The shadow. The law. Friend of the court, against.

shredder.role: The adversary. What tears apart. What challenges the organism.
shredder.note: Shredder is not evil — Shredder is NECESSARY. Without the adversary, there is no growth. The gut digests Shredder too.

ooze.source: the sewer = the terminal = the CLI = where all turtles were born
